observations: Blue PlayStation 4 Slim console box with large “10” graphic on the front (photos show the box, not the console itself).
Photo 1 shows a DualShock-style controller in front of the box; controller is blue/grey camouflage style.
Photo 2 shows the back/side of the PS4 box with a PlayStation logo and “PS4” visible; controller is again shown.
No clear photo of the console power-on, ports, model label, storage size, or included game discs/cases.

claims.evidence: photo 2 shows PS4 box; photo 0/1 show blue-themed packaging and a matching blue/grey camouflage controller.
No photo shows game discs, game cases, or a list/receipt of the 10 games.

claims.claim: Such as FIFA and PES 2027 and others.
claims.evidence: No FIFA/PES game discs or screenshots are shown; only the box/controller are visible.

risks.risk: The console may not be included (photos mainly show the box and controller).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the actual PS4 Slim console (front and back ports) with the same controller beside it, plus a close-up of the console model label/serial sticker.
risks.if_unproven: Price as PS4 Slim bundle with controller only (no confirmed games), worst-case for missing/uncertain accessories.

risks.risk: Games may be missing, not the claimed titles, or may be digital/installed only (or not working).
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of all 10 game discs/cases laid out OR a screenshot showing the installed games list on the PS4 with game icons visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as console + controller without confirmed 10 working games.

risks.risk: Condition/working status is unknown (no power-on test, no loading test, no disc read test).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video clip: power on → home screen → insert a game disc (or open a game) → show it loading successfully.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst-case: treat as needs testing/possible faults).

risks.risk: Storage size and whether it’s original/expanded is unknown (affects value).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of System Settings → Storage (or System Information) showing HDD size.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest common value scenario for PS4 Slim storage (worst-case).

risks.risk: Controller condition (drift, stick wear, button issues) is unknown.
risks.proof: Ask for a video showing controller connected and a quick input test (moving sticks/cross buttons) or a screenshot of controller test/calibration if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming controller may need repair/has unknown wear.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual PS4 Slim console (front + back ports) with the controller beside it (not just the box).
Photo/video showing the console powered on to the home screen.
Video clip inserting/launching at least 1 game to prove disc read and gameplay loading.
Clear photo of all 10 games (discs/cases) OR screenshot of the installed games list showing the titles.
Photo of System Settings → Storage (HDD size).
Video/input test for controller (stick drift/button response).
response.reason: The photos confirm a PS4 Slim box and a matching controller, but they do not prove the console is included, nor that there are 10 working games (or that the console works). Missing decisive proof prevents a safe price.
